entries.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war

entries.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial

entries.snippet: The groups have been active in Ethiopia's most populous regions for years and now say they will work together.

entries.title: UK should 'team up' with Canada in new Europe alliance, Canadian minister tells BBC

entries.title: Death of Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber being investigated as suspected overdose

entries.title: Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband says he forgave her so he would not be 'eaten up inside forever'

entries.snippet: While Burnham praised the agreement, Lib Dem leader Ed Davey called it a "pretend" victory for Trump.

entries.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
entries.snippet: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

entries.title: What the equinox 'henge' effect tells us about U.S. cities
entries.snippet: The fall equinox, which arrives Tuesday in the U.S., brings shorter days, and chances to witness alignment between Earth and the sun. It's a modern version of ancient observances of a celestial shift.

entries.title: Aviation regulators turn to AI to help manage the nation's airspace
entries.snippet: The Federal Aviation Administration launched an ambitious $875-million-dollar push to make the U.S. airspace more efficient. But critics say it won't solve bigger problems with air traffic control.

entries.title: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
entries.snippet: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

entries.title: World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'
entries.snippet: This week, world leaders convene for the U.N. General Assembly as war continues in Ukraine and the Gulf. And, President Trump has proposed that his arch serve as a military complex.

entries.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
entries.snippet: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

entries.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
entries.snippet: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

entries.title: Germany's leader stands his ground after his party loses in state elections
entries.snippet: German Chancellor Freidrich Merz conceded that the night spells "disaster" for the political center, but assured the public he'd push ahead with his federal agenda of tax and welfare reforms.

entries.title: What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week
entries.snippet: United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and the global body faces deep divisions.

entries.title: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
entries.snippet: With striking speed, the widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

entries.title: 18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited to U.S.
entries.snippet: Eighteen suspects who were arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse were being extradited to the U.S. on Sunday to face justice in Florida.

entries.snippet: A federal appeals panel has ruled in favor of new Missouri congressional districts backed by President Donald Trump. But there is no immediate impact from Monday's ruling.

entries.title: Britain's Burnham to meet Trump and make UN debut after offering UK military support for Saudis
entries.snippet: Britain's Prime Minister Andy Burnham is set to meet U.S. President Donald Trump for the first time.

entries.title: These copper vests are helping injured penguins heal faster
entries.snippet: An innovative treatment is helping injured penguins get back on their feet in Chile. Stephanie Sy reports on these special suits.

entries.snippet: Several of the nation's largest left-leaning voter engagement and racial justice organizations are facing steep funding shortfalls and staffing cutbacks.

entries.title: Up to 30 shots fired after man opened fire on officer outside Ontario synagogue
entries.snippet: A 29-year-old man opened fire on a police officer outside an Ontario synagogue during Yom Kippur, leading to a shootout with up to 30 shots fired.

entries.title: Jury convicts Vermont man of attempted murder in shooting of 3 Palestinian students
entries.snippet: A jury on Monday convicted a Vermont man of attempted murder in the shootings of three Palestinian college students who were walking near his home, rejecting an insanity defense rooted in his claims that he was acting on orders from the CIA and Mossad.

entries.title: Trump shows off new White House helipad, but networks skip coverage during First Amendment fight
entries.snippet: President Trump has unveiled a new White House helicopter landing pad while trying to downplay a First Amendment firestorm.

entries.title: Pope will retrace his missionary footsteps in Peru and finally visit Argentina in November
entries.snippet: Pope Leo XIV will retrace his steps as a missionary priest when he returns to Peru in November in his longest trip to date that will also take him to Uruguay and Argentina, where his Argentine predecessor Pope Francis never returned.

entries.title: Firefighting helicopter crashes near Yosemite, killing both pilots
entries.snippet: Two helicopter pilots were killed when their aircraft crashed Sunday afternoon while conducting water drops on a wildfire at Yosemite National Park, officials say.

entries.title: States settle lawsuit over Paramount-Warner merger, clearing key hurdle for $81 billion deal
entries.snippet: The agreement calls for Paramount to increase domestic production and establish monitoring of editorial independence of the company's news operations.

entries.title: Technical problems at a key air traffic center disrupt flights across Northeast
entries.snippet: On Monday morning, the primary circuit that carries data into that air traffic control facility failed, affecting flights for Philadelphia as well as Kennedy, LaGuardia and Newark airports, the Federal Aviation Administration said.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: US-China rivalry is reshaping global trade — and Europe is caught in the middle.
entries.snippet: China's Xi Jinping is traveling to Washington this week. Regardless of what comes from his talks with US President Trump, the EU will likely remain stuck between erratic US trade policy and Beijing's export machine.

entries.title: US news outlets sue Trump over White House ban
entries.snippet: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico say the ban against them threatens press freedom and the right to independent journalism.

entries.title: Nuclear power is back on Southeast Asia's energy agenda
entries.snippet: Rising electricity demand, shocks in energy security and climate commitments are reviving long-stalled plans for nuclear power across Southeast Asia. But proponents of nuclear energy still face major obstacles.

entries.title: Why gender-based violence persists in Southern Africa
entries.snippet: A series of killings in South Africa has renewed scrutiny of efforts to combat violence against women. Activists say laws alone are not enough without effective implementation.

entries.title: India's road rage: When cars become weapons
entries.snippet: Road disputes are turning violent across India, raising questions about status and impunity behind the wheel for drivers of expensive cars.

entries.title: Russia: Putin party retains majority in controlled parliamentary vote
entries.snippet: Vladimir Putin's United Russia won just under 58% of the vote, the electoral commission said. Meanwhile, Putin ally Ramzan Kadyrov won nearly 100% of the vote in elections in the Russian republic of Chechnya.

entries.title: Germany news: Trial starts of ex-Transport Minister Scheuer
entries.snippet: Former Transport Minister Andreas Scheuer is being tried for perjury related to a failed car toll scheme. And cherry farmers have brought in a bumper harvest.

entries.title: Pakistan says strikes in Afghanistan killed '28 terrorists'
entries.snippet: The Afghan border provinces of Kunar and Paktika were struck overnight. Pakistan said 28 militants were killed, Afghanistan said three civilians died. This follows soon after an attack on police in Kohat, Pakistan.

entries.title: Germany's car crisis: Can the 35-hour workweek survive?
entries.snippet: German carmakers want employees to work 40 hours instead of the current 35 without extra pay, arguing it would improve competitiveness. Unions strongly oppose the proposal and view it as an attack on workers' rights.

entries.title: US proposes AI safety mechanism in talks with China
entries.snippet: US Treasury chief Scott Bessent said there had been "successful" talks with China on trade and AI. The talks come amid growing fears that AI could pose an existential threat to humanity.

entries.title: India news: India's medal tally at Asian games rises to six
entries.snippet: Indian athletes won two bronze and two silver medals on the second day of the Asian Games in Japan. Meanwhile, more bodies were recovered after a flash flood in Kerala. DW has more.

entries.title: Japan: Typhoon Dujuan sparks flood, landslide warnings
entries.snippet: Evacuation advisories have been issued and hundreds of flights have been canceled in Japan, which is in the middle of a five-day holiday. The storm could dump record levels of rain on the country.

entries.title: US: Man wounded in Texas after being shot by ICE agent
entries.snippet: An ICE agent shot and wounded a man in Austin, Texas. The city's mayor has called for an independent investigation into the shooting.

entries.title: Iran closes language center in Tehran, France vows response
entries.snippet: In response to the Iranian authorities' decision to close a French language center affiliated with its embassy in Tehran, France vowed to take appropriate measures.

entries.title: Canada, France agree to closer ties in defense, economy
entries.snippet: Amid strained relations with the US, French President Emmanuel Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced closer economic and defense ties.

entries.title: German state elections deal a blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz
entries.snippet: Elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania have dealt the CDU a historic defeat while the AfD saw a massive gain. The pressure on Germany's unpopular chancellor is mounting.

entries.title: AfD makes gains in state elections but has no government options
entries.snippet: Despite making significant gains in both Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, the far-right AfD remains without options to form a state government.

entries.title: Germany faces energy tax losses as EV sales rise
entries.snippet: The rapid shift to electric vehicles in Germany is cutting fuel tax revenue for the government. As EV sales surge, policymakers face growing pressure to find new ways to fund roads and transportation infrastructure.

entries.title: Peter Thiel: Power, Palantir, and the antichrist
entries.snippet: He was early to back Facebook, early to back Donald Trump, and is one of the world’s richest people. But from his theories on the antichrist and AI to his distinctive politics, Peter Thiel is hard to pin down.
